question: Which of the following ministries has been allotted to Pratap Chandra Sarangi as a minister of State in current Central Government (as of Dec 2020)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• As of December 2020, Pratap Chandra Sarangi was serving as a Minister of State in the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) and the Ministry of Animal Husbandry, Dairying and Fisheries in the central government of India.
 
• Pratap Chandra Sarangi is an Indian politician who has been serving as a Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha, representing the Balasore constituency in Odisha.
 
• In the Narendra Modi-led government, which came to power in May 2019,
 
 
• Pratap Chandra Sarangi was appointed as Minister of State (MoS) with responsibilities in two specific ministries:
 
• Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME):
 
 
• This ministry is focused on promoting and developing small businesses and enterprises in India, which are crucial to the country's economic growth and employment.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Animal Husbandry, Dairying and Fisheries:
 
 
• This ministry is dedicated to improving the sectors related to livestock, dairy production, and fisheries, which play a vital role in rural livelihoods and the overall food security of India.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ministry of Textiles:
 
 
• This ministry is responsible for overseeing the textile industry in India, which includes cotton, jute, silk, wool, and synthetic fibre.
 
• It formulates policies and initiatives to promote the growth and modernization of the textile sector, aiming to enhance India's competitiveness in the global textile market.
 
• This ministry also addresses the welfare of workers in the textile industry and encourages investments in the sector.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs:
 
 
• This ministry plays a key role in coordinating between the government and Parliament.
 
• It is responsible for the management of legislative and other business in both Houses of Parliament.
 
• The ministry ensures the smooth functioning of parliamentary procedures, organizes parliamentary sessions and liaises with various parliamentary committees.
 
• It also facilitates the passage of government bills and issues related to parliamentary privileges and practices.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Education:
 
 
• Known earlier as the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), this ministry is responsible for the implementation and formulation of national policies on education.
 
• It oversees various educational institutions, ensures quality standards in education, and works on improving access to education at all levels—primary, secondary, and higher education.
